info.title: Cities API - Get City Data for Any Country
info.description: Retrieve all cities for a given country with their latitude, longitude, administrative unit details, and ISO country code. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes. Optionally filter by administrative unit code using the `admin_unit` parameter to narrow results to a specific region or province; an admin_unit code that doesn't exist for the country returns a 400 error here (unlike the Administrative Units endpoint's admin_level filter, which returns an empty array for an unknown level). Each city result includes name, coordinates, admin unit information (name, code, level), and the two-letter country code. There is no pagination: large countries return every city in one response. A valid country code is required.

get.summary: Retrieve cities for a country with optional admin unit filtering
get.description: Returns all cities for a country, optionally filtered by administrative unit. Each city includes name, coordinates, admin unit details, and ISO country code.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format (e.g., US, PK).

parameters.name: admin_unit
parameters.description: Administrative unit code used to filter cities within a specific region. An admin_unit code that doesn't exist for the specified country returns a 400 error, not an empty result.

200.description: Successful response with list of cities

400.description: Bad Request — Missing country parameter, invalid country code, or admin_unit code not found for the country

value.message: Only ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes country codes are supported.

InvalidAdminCode.summary: admin_unit code does not exist for the given country

value.message: Please provide a valid admin code.

404.description: Not Found — Country is a recognized ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code but has no cities in the database (e.g. Vatican City)

value.message: This country does not have any cities associated with it.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

CitiesResponse.description: Response containing every city for the requested country (optionally filtered by admin_unit), returned unpaginated in a single array.

cities.description: An array of city objects for the specified country, optionally filtered by admin unit.

CityItem.description: A city object containing name, coordinates, admin unit, and country code.

latitude.description: The geographic latitude of the city in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: The geographic longitude of the city in decimal degrees.

iso_alpha_2.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code the city belongs to.

AdminUnit.description: An object describing the administrative unit the city belongs to.

name.description: The full name of the administrative unit.

admin_code.description: The short code of the administrative unit.

admin_level.description: The administrative level type of the unit (e.g., province, council area).

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.
